issues.acceptance: A representative native-renderer before/after capture reports raw frame times, one-percent low, hitch count, CPU/GPU attribution, and named script hot paths with 3, 5, 10, and 18 active enemies. Enemy separation is computed once from a cached stable roster per physics cycle, QA instrumentation performs no per-frame deep state snapshot or scene-wide scan in ordinary play, and AI behavior/spacing remains unchanged. llvmpipe evidence is recorded only as collector evidence.
issues.actual: scripts/enemy_agent.gd rebuilds and sorts the complete fusepoint_enemy group inside _separation_safe_velocity(), then invokes that admission path multiple times per navigation cycle for every active enemy. At the same time, the main scene runs RuntimeQualificationProbe in PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS, deep-calls mission/roster/weapon state and periodically scans the complete scene tree for audio players. With 18 active enemies these are credible CPU hitch hot paths and must be profiled on a native renderer; the llvmpipe collector result cannot attribute the user's stutter to their computer.
issues.expected: Ordinary gameplay performs bounded enemy steering and lightweight production work per frame; deep QA snapshots run only on demand or at a bounded debug sampling cadence.

open_issues.acceptance: A representative native-renderer before/after capture reports raw frame times, one-percent low, hitch count, CPU/GPU attribution, and named script hot paths with 3, 5, 10, and 18 active enemies. Enemy separation is computed once from a cached stable roster per physics cycle, QA instrumentation performs no per-frame deep state snapshot or scene-wide scan in ordinary play, and AI behavior/spacing remains unchanged. llvmpipe evidence is recorded only as collector evidence.
open_issues.actual: scripts/enemy_agent.gd rebuilds and sorts the complete fusepoint_enemy group inside _separation_safe_velocity(), then invokes that admission path multiple times per navigation cycle for every active enemy. At the same time, the main scene runs RuntimeQualificationProbe in PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS, deep-calls mission/roster/weapon state and periodically scans the complete scene tree for audio players. With 18 active enemies these are credible CPU hitch hot paths and must be profiled on a native renderer; the llvmpipe collector result cannot attribute the user's stutter to their computer.
open_issues.expected: Ordinary gameplay performs bounded enemy steering and lightweight production work per frame; deep QA snapshots run only on demand or at a bounded debug sampling cadence.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from prior tuning: repair the authoritative product shell/media chain for the opening issue, and repair or replace the humanoid animation state binding for the enemy rifle pose issue.
